body.text: A flexible MBA for working professionals who want to step into senior leadership without pausing their careers. Study online, at your own pace, alongside a global cohort.
What you will study
Core modules cover strategy, finance, marketing, operations and leadership, followed by electives and a final consultancy project with a real organisation.
Who it is for
Managers with at least three years of professional experience who are ready to lead larger teams and make strategic decisions.
Designed for experienced executives, this programme combines online study with optional in-person residencies in Europe and the Gulf.
Programme highlights
Learn from senior faculty and industry leaders, build a strong peer network, and apply each module directly to challenges in your own organisation.
A professional doctorate for senior leaders who want to research a real business problem and contribute new practical knowledge to their field.
How it works
After taught research modules, you work one-to-one with a supervisor on a thesis grounded in your own industry.
An academic research degree for professionals who want to make an original contribution to management theory.
Research areas
Supervision is available in leadership, organisational behaviour, strategy, sustainability and digital transformation.
Build the skills to plan, deliver and lead complex projects across industries, with content aligned to recognised professional standards.
Career outcomes
Graduates move into project, programme and portfolio management roles in construction, technology, government and consulting.
A practical masters for HR professionals who want to shape people strategy, culture and performance in their organisation.
What you will study
Modules include talent management, employment law, reward, organisational change and people analytics.
For teachers and school leaders who want to deepen their practice and move into leadership or curriculum roles.
Specialisms
Choose a pathway in educational leadership, teaching and learning, or inclusive education.
A complete undergraduate business degree you can study while working, covering the foundations of management, finance and marketing.
Entry requirements
Applicants need a high school certificate or equivalent. Relevant work experience may also be considered.
